ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Msiexec Execute Arbitrary DLL
ruleDefinitions.description:
Adversaries may abuse msiexec.exe to proxy execution of malicious payloads.
Msiexec.exe is the command-line utility for the Windows Installer and is thus commonly associated with executing installation packages (.msi)

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-y.*")) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\MsiExec\\\.exe\\"\\ \\/Y\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Bonjour\\\\mdnsNSP\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\MsiExec\\\.exe\\"\\ \\/Y\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Bonjour\\\\mdnsNSP\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\MsiExec\\\.exe\\"\\ \\/Y\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Apple\\ Software\\ Update\\\\ScriptingObjectModel\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\MsiExec\\\.exe\\"\\ \\/Y\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Apple\\ Software\\ Update\\\\SoftwareUpdateAdmin\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\MsiExec\\\.exe\\"\\ \\/Y\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\CCM\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\MsiExec\\\.exe\\"\\ \\/Y\\ C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\CCM\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\MsiExec\\\.exe\\"\\ \\-Y\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Bonjour\\\\mdnsNSP\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\MsiExec\\\.exe\\"\\ \\-Y\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Bonjour\\\\mdnsNSP\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\MsiExec\\\.exe\\"\\ \\-Y\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Apple\\ Software\\ Update\\\\ScriptingObjectModel\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\MsiExec\\\.exe\\"\\ \\-Y\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Apple\\ Software\\ Update\\\\SoftwareUpdateAdmin\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\MsiExec\\\.exe\\"\\ \\-Y\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\CCM\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\MsiExec\\\.exe\\"\\ \\-Y\\ C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\CCM\\\\.*")))
